_doc: Glossary preserve-list. Terms here MUST remain English in zh_TW translations. forbidden_zh_substitutes lists Chinese strings that, if present, indicate a glossary violation. Note: the verb 'Manage' (used in CTAs like 'Manage PCE Cache') is intentionally NOT listed — it naturally renders as 管理 in Traditional Chinese menus/buttons. The product nouns 'Managed' and 'Unmanaged' (e.g. 'Managed Workload') remain whitelisted because they are Illumio product states.
_doc_exempt_keys: Keys whose zh_TW value is allowed to drop a preserved term, listed with the term(s) they may drop. The left-hand navigation is the operator's map of the product and was asked for in Traditional Chinese; the terms themselves stay English everywhere else (reports, CLI, page bodies), which is why this is a per-key exemption and not a removal from preserve_in_zh_tw.
